issues.description: The bounded local SAS probes confirm sampled readability and columns only. The full date bounds, source vintage, units, population and required history remain unverified; the scripts use 1960+ annual/quarterly inputs, 11 monthly lags, daily observations through the 2020 Q1 window, and 2019–20 IBES inputs.

Neither supplied SAS program specifies a LIBNAME/include setup. The source uses COMPD, CRSPQ, CRSP, FF and IBES directly; the local catalog exposes the CRSP products under CRSP.*, so a CRSPQ-to-local mapping and the authorized working library setup need confirmation. This is a setup/compatibility question, not proof that the products are absent.
The active WRDS WINSORIZE macro calls %nwords(&vars), but the macro definition is not supplied in either SAS program. Its availability in the intended WRDS/local SAS macro environment is unknown.

Figure 6 appends a distinct FactSet file named FactSetReturns110520_111720.dta. The datasheet identifies its November 2020 source/date, but it is absent from the package and no compatible access route or fields/history have been verified. It is not interchangeable with the CRSP tables in the supplied program.

The existing empty-session SAS probe fails during TKELS initialization. The local SAS runtime/version and PROC EXPORT DBMS=DTA support remain unverified; this does not establish entitlement or rule out the documented WRDS cloud environment.

The SAS producers write three DTA files under [redacted-path-23ddccf20ba3], while Stata expects them under [redacted-path-5af06322f7f2]; Stata also writes outputs to an author-specific Overleaf Results path. Relocate these routine roots consistently in a working copy and run from one project root.
